blocks.title: Donate
blocks.text:
_“Processing has enabled thousands of creatives, myself included, to think, experiment, create, and express ourselves through code. These tools have given us the opportunity to learn as a community, share our work with the world, and develop an artistic practice. Supporting the people who maintain them recognizes that open-source software is a cultural infrastructure that makes new forms of creation, learning, and collaboration possible.”_

 – Juan Rodríguez García

Over a quarter-century, Processing has turned code into a creative medium, empowering artists, educators, and students to build interactive 2D and 3D graphics. Donate today to invest in the next generation of Processing.

blocks.title: Why Your Support Matters
blocks.body:
Processing is both a software and a community, woven together by creators pushing the boundaries of interactivity across visual arts, generative design, and computer graphics. 

The tool is open-source and built through collaboration and mentorship. Your support helps maintain Processing and develop new ideas, making it available to millions of creators worldwide.

items.title: Developers in Residence and Open Source Microgrants

items.title: Core Maintenance
items.description: Keeping the tools stable and reliable, guided by Project Leads and experienced contributors.

items.title: Infrastructure and Security
items.description: Upgrades that keep releases safe and aligned with other libraries built on the core tools.

items.title: Accessibility
items.description: Ensuring artists, educators, and learners of all abilities can use these tools effectively.

items.title: Community
items.description: Advising, testing, and review that sustains a strong open-source ecosystem.
